paragraphs: Mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 53:10. The statement in Bamidbar Rabbah 23:7 is attributed to R' Yannai the Kohen.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ב״ר פנ״ג־י and במדבר רבה פכ״ג־ז are read as Bereshit Rabbah 53:10 and Bamidbar Rabbah 23:7. The complete second label is preserved here; neither locus is independently checked against a named edition.

ע״ש is read contextually as attributed/in the name of, rather than see-there, in this statement-attribution formula. The different speakers and full Kohen designation remain. Older machine מנהמה differs from supplied מנחמה; both personal title abbreviations remain R'.
